meta.scope: The LIVE proof plan (A53-A60 stratification composition), i.e. exactly the axiom roster of lean/PackingCertMathlib/PackingCertMathlib/TopLevel.lean. The superseded A38/T0 far-field composition is represented only by its off-tree remnants (X.* nodes). Each node's `lean_axiom` field names the axiom in TopLevel.lean it feeds, when one exists.

labels.proved-prose: a human-readable proof exists in the repo (docs/proofs/ or attempt notes); not formalised
labels.certificate+verifier: established by exact certificate(s) checked by a named verifier
labels.cited: external result or trusted third-party component
labels.conjecture: labelled conjecture/extrapolated/[NUM] in the repo; NOT usable in the proof
labels.open: no proof, no certificate; an obligation

edge_kinds.uses: load-bearing dependency: the source cannot be established without the target
edge_kinds.motivation: informed the search/design only; the source does not logically depend on the target

h11_sweep.verdict: ZERO nodes labelled 'conjecture' are load-bearing in the live composition. The go/no-go criterion 'dependency graph has zero conjecture nodes' is MET on labels — but 12 nodes are labelled 'open', of which three (A.UBshat, A.UNIQ, B.EXACT) were only surfaced by writing the formal statement (F3). The proof's distance-to-done is measured in open nodes, not conjectures: A.PARAM, A.S3, A.UBshat, A.UNIQ, A.F2(prose->Lean is F-track, prose itself fine), B.EXACT, C.K4TIER (largest), C.A61, D.TREE, D.LADDER, D.SLAB, D.D4, D.S6, E.COORD.
